column1: # AsyncAPI 2.x and 3.x counters, YAML or JSON, for a rule with the prompt file-body-contract: one
# per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks YAML comments (a whole line, or
# from a # after a blank) and the body of a block scalar (the lines below a | or > that are deeper
# than its key, past a list item's dash, as deep as the first of them, which sets the block's
# indentation as YAML reads it; its key stays, an empty scalar blanks no sibling key), so a
# description that quotes a channel or a "type: object" does not count. A double-quoted string that
# holds a # is blanked whole, so its # opens no comment: "Posts to #general" in a one-line JSON
# document blanks nothing after it (a string not closed on its line ends there). A key that is quoted
# and holds a : opens no block scalar. A key counts with or without JSON
# quotes. "channel addresses" counts the address of a 3.x (a value on its line, so a schema property
# named address, which opens a mapping, does not count) channel; "operations" a 2.x publish or
# subscribe that opens a mapping and a 3.x action send or receive; "payloads" the payload of every
# message. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every
